## About Monash Sport

<!-- Presenter: Ayush -->

- **Health, fitness & wellbeing**
- **Sports facilities & community engagement**
- **Industry mentors:** Alicia Stack & Darren McLeod
- **Our project:** Data-driven dashboard for Monash Sport

## Business Problem & Objectives

<!-- Presenter: Ayush -->

### Business Problem
- Outdated, Excel-based reporting
- Multiple files and manual navigation
- Difficult to interpret and compare data

### Objectives
- Simplify and modernise data analysis
- Develop an interactive dashboard
- Provide a single-view summary for reporting and presentations

## Our Thinking

<!-- Presenter: Ayush -->
- **Easy access:** Web-based dashboard via URL
- **Simple uploads:** Select and upload Excel reports
- **Technology:** R and ShinyLive
- **Visual insights:** Interactive graphs & KPIs
- **Two views:** Overall summary & detailed analysis
- **Data coverage:** Income, expenses, attendance, court & venue hire and many more 

## Challenges and Our Approach

<!-- Presenters: Vicky / Ayush -->

### Data Challenges

- **Different layouts:** Report structures vary across files and years.
- **Overlapping totals:** Summary and detailed rows require careful aggregation.
- **Data quality:** Missing values and inconsistent totals need validation.

### Dashboard Visualisation Challenges

- **Layout constraints:** Graphs struggled to fit and remain readable.
- **Data complexity:** Multiple subcategories required separate visualisations.

## Results

<!-- Presenter: Vicky -->

- **Data preparation:** Upload, validate and review Excel reports.
- **Performance analysis:** Review overall results and compare sites.
- **Operational detail:** Explore site activity and venue operations.
- **Planning:** Test payroll and pricing scenarios.

## In & Out of Scope

<!-- Presenter: Vicky -->

### In Scope

- Financial and operational reporting from supported Excel files
- Comparisons across sites, facilities and reporting periods
- Income and expense forecasting with user-defined scenarios

### Out of Scope

- Live booking and payroll administration
- Automatic staffing or facility allocation
- Importing arbitrary Excel layouts

## Conclusion

- The dashboard brings financial and operational reports together.
- Users can review overall performance and compare sites and facilities.
- Forecasting supports planning around changes in costs and prices.
